requirements: R1: The application's health endpoint must be accessible on the configured port.
R2: The backup container must execute its scripts without permission errors.

slices.title: Repair runtime environment initialization failures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime environment initialization fix for this epic, I want to repair container configurations and permissions, so that the product launches successfully and passes health checks
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment of the system
When the containers are launched
Then the backup container must execute its script successfully
And the application's health endpoint must return a healthy status code
